narrative.overview:
The page is laid like the logo's parquet: a 45 degree plank grid of real floors, set in warm black lacquer and gold leaf, with white oak for the light passages. Photographs are planks; gold is the seam between them. The hero is the logo diamond rebuilt at roughly viewport height from five clipped photo planks, and the same diamond recurs everywhere small: chip markers, list bullets, map pins, process markers, the before/after knob, the 3D room pins.

Sections alternate between two grounds. Dark lacquer passages (hero, services, work, why, FAQ, estimate, footer) carry bone text and gold accents; white oak passages (about, compare, reviews, process) carry ink text over a real oak grain plate washed at 90% oak. A two-course gold plank strip with black seams (the threshold) marks the hand-off from hero to page. Every corner is square; depth comes from lacquer tone steps, gold hairlines and the photographs themselves, not from rounded cards.

Every service owns one sample code, No. 01 to No. 06, reused across the hero chips, the 3D room tabs and pins, the compare table, the footer list and the estimate form. The signature interaction is a lit Three.js cutaway house: choosing a service lights its part in gold and flies the camera there. Light is state.
keyCharacteristics: Square corners everywhere (0px), including third-party widgets.
Gold leaf is a gradient (128deg, five stops), never a flat yellow, on every large gold fill.
Black seams (2 to 6px) between photos and gold, as in real parquet.
The diamond (45 degree square) is the only ornament.
Sample codes No. 01 to No. 06 tie every service surface together.
Photos carry one corner chip naming room and material.

rules.name: The Leaf Not Paint Rule
rules.body: Any gold surface larger than a mark is the leaf gradient. Flat `gold` is reserved for marks under about 16px and for text.

rules.name: The No Grey Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is lacquer, oak, bone or taupe. Gold hairlines are `rgba(201, 150, 58, a)` at 0.14 (inner dividers), 0.25 (container rules) and 0.35 (field and container edges); hover lifts them to `rgba(217, 184, 102, 0.7 to 0.8)`.

rules.name: The One Code Rule
rules.body: A service is always introduced with its sample code in tabular gold numerals before its name, and the code is the same on every surface.

rules.name: The Serif Never Bolds Rule
rules.body: Gloock stays at 400. Emphasis in display text is color (soft gilt), not weight.

rules.name: The Lacquer Step Rule
rules.body: Raise a surface by stepping lacquer to lacquer-2 or lacquer-3 and adding a gold hairline, not by adding a shadow.

dos: Do use the leaf gradient for every gold fill larger than a mark, and on-gold ink (#150f08) for anything sitting on it.
Do keep every corner square (0px), including embedded widgets.
Do separate photos from gold with solid seams (6px in the portfolio, 8px in the board bed).
Do label every photo with one bottom-left chip: room and material, led by a gold diamond.
Do introduce each service with its sample code (No. 01 LVP, 02 Laminate, 03 Hardwood, 04 Refinishing, 05 Stairs, 06 Trim) in tabular gold.
Do alternate lacquer and white oak passages; on oak, switch text to ink and walnut ink and the button to ink.
Do ease everything with `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` and gate entrances and plank drift behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`.
donts: Don't introduce cool or neutral greys; every neutral is warm lacquer, oak, bone or taupe.
Don't fill large surfaces with flat yellow gold.
Don't round corners or add pill shapes.
Don't bold Gloock; emphasis in display type is soft gilt.
Don't use shadows to separate panels; step the lacquer and add a gold hairline.
